description: This file defines a core class 'Class' for the Leaflet library, including methods for inheritance, mixins, options merging, and constructor hooks.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: A base class providing inheritance, mixin, and hook functionalities for Leaflet components.

methods.name: Class.extend
methods.description: Creates a new class that inherits from the current class, with additional properties and static members.

methods.name: Class.include
methods.description: Includes a mixin into the class prototype.

methods.name: Class.mergeOptions
methods.description: Merges options into the class's default options.

methods.name: Class.addInitHook
methods.description: Adds a constructor hook to be called during class instantiation.
